purpose: Address the valid E14 DEV blocker upstream of the selective reprocess boundary by making visible-evidence coverage, endpoint consideration, and decision/action consistency explicit for the GPT-OSS replacement model.

candidate_change.name: gpt_oss_visible_evidence_endpoint_decision_reconciliation
requirements: plan a broad concrete evidence surface using only public repository tool/API contracts
distinguish planned evidence acquisition from claims that evidence has already been observed
explicitly consider each supported action endpoint against visible support and blockers
select a concrete safe action when visible support is sufficient instead of defaulting to investigate-only
keep action and escalation decisions independent but internally consistent
preserve the existing E14 selective reprocess authorization boundary after model output

full_remeasurement_condition: Only a complete E14b DEV run that passes every unchanged private-scoring threshold may authorize a measurement-only DEV+VALIDATION rerun. VALIDATION remains forbidden for tuning.
